notes: 静态向量；本轮不执行。current-state 用于冻结缺口，target-acceptance 在 G0/T1 后作为门禁。所有路径使用临时目录占位符，不写真实凭据/home 路径。

vectors.title: 当前 host bin 对 SIGTERM 走默认处置，不产生 drain
vectors.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(mktemp -d)"
host_bin="${HOST_BIN:-chimera-host/target/debug/chimera-host}"
test -x "$host_bin"
"$host_bin" "$root" >"$root/out" 2>"$root/err" &
pid=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$root"' EXIT
sleep 1
kill -TERM "$pid"
set +e
wait "$pid"
status=$?
set -e
printf 'exit=%s\n' "$status"
vectors.cleanup: trap 删除临时目录并等待 host 退出
vectors.notes: 若未来接入信号处理，本向量会从 pass 变为 fail，提示 current-state 漂移；此时应更新文档而不是放宽判定。

vectors.title: SIGTERM 后 host 完成 graceful drain 并以 0 退出，worker 无孤儿
vectors.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(mktemp -d)"
host_bin="${HOST_BIN:-chimera-host/target/debug/chimera-host}"
test -x "$host_bin"
"$host_bin" "$root" --db "$root/host.db" --worker 1 --worker-cmd bun run packages/chimera/src/index.ts bun-worker "$root/ws" >"$root/out" 2>"$root/err" &
pid=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$root"' EXIT
sleep 2
kill -TERM "$pid"
set +e
wait "$pid"
status=$?
set -e
if pgrep -f "bun-worker $root/ws" >/dev/null; then echo "orphan worker"; exit 1; fi
printf 'exit=%s\n' "$status"
vectors.cleanup: trap 删除临时目录并确保 worker 不残留

vectors.title: worker 崩溃后 host 按退避重启并递增 generation
vectors.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(mktemp -d)"
host_bin="${HOST_BIN:-chimera-host/target/debug/chimera-host}"
test -x "$host_bin"
"$host_bin" "$root" --db "$root/host.db" --worker 1 --worker-cmd bun run packages/chimera/src/index.ts bun-worker "$root/ws" >"$root/out" 2>"$root/err" &
pid=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$root"' EXIT
sleep 2
child="$(pgrep -P "$pid" | head -n 1)"
test -n "$child"
kill -KILL "$child"
sleep 3
spawn_count="$(grep -c 'worker workspace=' "$root/err" || true)"
printf 'spawn_count=%s\n' "$spawn_count"
if [ "$spawn_count" -lt 2 ]; then echo "no restart"; exit 1; fi
vectors.cleanup: trap 终止 host 并删除临时目录
vectors.notes: 命令断言 spawn_count>=2；当前 bin 只 spawn 一次，因此 expected_today=fail。

vectors.title: host 重启 sweep 把无 live generation 的 running turn 标为 interrupted
vectors.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(mktemp -d)"
db="$root/host.db"
sqlite3 "$db" < packages/chimera/migration/20261022022937_host_control_plane/migration.sql
sqlite3 "$db" "INSERT INTO session_turn_checkpoint (session_id,turn_id,turn_seq,generation,status,commit_state,intent,resume_policy,side_effect_state,created_at,updated_at) VALUES ('ses_x','turn_x',1,1,'running','pending','{}','auto','unknown',1,1);"
host_bin="${HOST_BIN:-chimera-host/target/debug/chimera-host}"
test -x "$host_bin"
"$host_bin" "$root" --db "$db" >"$root/out" 2>"$root/err" &
pid=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$root"' EXIT
sleep 2
kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
status="$(sqlite3 "$db" "SELECT status FROM session_turn_checkpoint WHERE session_id='ses_x' AND turn_id='turn_x';")"
printf 'status=%s\n' "$status"
test "$status" = "interrupted"
vectors.cleanup: trap 终止 host 并删除临时目录

vectors.title: 当前 bin 没有 try_restart/request_drain 接线
vectors.command:
if rg -q "try_restart|request_drain" chimera-host/src/bin/chimera-host.rs; then echo "unexpected wiring"; exit 1; fi
echo "no restart/drain wiring"
